title: test_bl_land's rejected-push fake clones a remote whose HEAD names master
goal: The fake kbgit.py of test_bl_land's LAND_REJECT case clones the remote's main by name (clone -b main), so on a host whose git config sets init.defaultBranch=master (Git for Windows' system gitconfig), where the fixture's bare remote's HEAD names a branch that does not exist, the other session's commit sits on main and its push is a fast-forward; both rejected-push land tests pass on Windows
